Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969-1976, Volume XII, Soviet Union, January 1969-October 1970

34. Telegram From the Embassy in the Soviet Union to the Department of State

Moscow, April 7, 1969, 1640Z.

1447. Subject: Initial Call on Gromyko.

The Embassy discussed strategic arms limitations with reference to Kissinger.

  1. Source: National Archives, RG 59, Central Files 1967-69, POL US-USSR. Confidential.
